# Forge Web

Forge Web (https://forgeweb.app) is a free browser interface for Magic: The
Gathering playtesting against AI, powered by the open-source Card-Forge rules
engine. No game download is required.

## What you can do

### Watch games

The homepage at https://forgeweb.app/ shows AI-versus-AI games. Watching does
not require an account. A new game follows each result.

### Import a deck and play

Sign in with an email code to import, edit and save decks in your account
library and play against AI. Standard and Commander are the current focus.
Deck imports resolve card names from the pinned Forge catalog. Catalog
availability does not guarantee that every interaction works in browser play.

## Current limitations

- Draft, sealed and the general puzzle browser are parked.
- Match replay is a development tool, not a public product feature.
- Play is against AI. Human multiplayer is not currently offered.
- Desktop is the best experience. Mobile layout and board interaction are still being refined.
- Availability of a card does not imply every interaction has been verified in browser play.

## Technology

The interface uses React, TypeScript and Vite. A Kotlin product server runs
the rules engine and handles accounts, saved decks and game sessions. The
browser uses HTTP APIs and a WebSocket game connection. The engine does not
run entirely in the browser. Card artwork is served through Scryfall.

## Questions

Is it free? Yes, watching and playing are free.

Do I need an account? Watching does not require an account. Saving decks and playing require email sign-in.

Do I need to install anything? No game installation is required to use the
website. A web app manifest is supplied for browsers that support adding the
site to a home screen. Gameplay requires an internet connection.

How do I contact the project? Use the contact form linked from
https://forgeweb.app/about.
